DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The chest X-ray showing ground-glass opacities and air bronchograms, combined with the acidotic ABG results (low pH, elevated CO2, low O2) and the history of a 32-week preterm birth, strongly confirm RDS. No further testing is required to establish this diagnosis.
